thread:
Aisha (Support): Morning — heads up: ticket volume spiked ~35% overnight. Most are payment retries after a gateway timeout window. Top samples: S-4321, S-4324, S-4330. Could we standardize a quick macro for affected customers?

ops-bot: Alert: payment-gateway timeout rate increased 4x at 03:12 UTC. New tickets created: 12. Link: https://incidents.example/1749

Ben (Support): I drafted a short macro, putting it here for quick copy/paste:

```
We're seeing intermittent payment retries due to upstream gateway timeouts. Our engineers are investigating. If you've been charged multiple times, please reply and we'll escalate for a refund. Thank you for your patience. — Redwood Support
```

Ben (Support): Suggest we add an optional sentence for customers in affected regions (EU/US). thoughts? :thinking_face:

Aisha (Support): Looks good. Can we add a line about expected ETA (working on it, updates in ~60m)? Also add the refund escalation link. I'll paste the final macro to the macros channel after small tweak.

Lina (Docs): Minor wording nit: replace "engineers are investigating" with "our payment team is investigating" to avoid confusion. I can submit a 1-line PR to macros repo.

Ben (Support): @Diego can you give a quick sanity check on infra before we push the macro? Want to avoid promising ETA if backend still flapping.

Diego (Infra): On it. I'm on-call — checking the gateway metrics now. Will review logs and the retry window. I can confirm in ~20–30m. If we see persistent 5xxs we should open an engineering incident.

Ben (Support): If anyone needs to pull logs quickly: use this query (Cloud logs):

```
jsonPayload.service="payments" OR jsonPayload.error_code=~"gateway.*"
| timestamp > -2h
```

Aisha (Support): quick ask — can ops-bot post current queue counts? want to snapshot before macros roll out.

ops-bot: Queue snapshot: open tickets: 76 (+20 since last), payment-related: 27, high-priority: 4. Avg SLA wait: 18m.

Diego (Infra): Confirmed transient spikes from gateway region us-east-1 between 02:50–03:40 UTC. Error rate peaked at 6%. I don't see full outage, looks like upstream retries. Recommend: 1) push macro, 2) monitor, 3) hold escalation unless >10% sustained for 15m.

Aisha (Support): Thanks. I'll post macro with Lina's wording tweak and include refund/escalation links. Assigning follow-ups: Ben — monitor replies and tag refunds; Lina — PR to macros repo; Diego — keep an eye on metrics for next hour.

Ben (Support): taking refunds/watch. I'll ping infra if it moves.

Lina (Docs): PR ready, linking after I push: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/88

Aisha (Support): Today: monitor queue, push macro, update affected customers, log any refund escalations to #billing-escalations. Blockers: none atm, waiting on Diego for escalation threshold.

ops-bot: Reminder: standup wrap at 10:30 PT. React with :white_check_mark: when you've accepted tasks.
